_comment: Single source of truth for domain-level metadata. Regenerated docs (INDEX.md / CATALOG.md / catalog.yaml / manifest.json) all read this file. Edit here, never in the generated outputs.

_schema.label: 中文域名
_schema.what: CATALOG.md 里的『能做什么』一句话
_schema.triggers: INDEX.md L0 路由表的触发词，逗号分隔
_schema.authority: domain = 我们权威，插件不得接管；process = 通用工艺，插件可主导
_schema.plugin_priority: true = 该域与已装插件能力重叠，Agent 先查插件
_schema.plugin_overlap: 与插件重叠的具体技能（仅 plugin_priority=true 时有值）
